enterTarget(address,uint256).notice: Send idle vault USDC into an allowlisted venue. Locked after the recall deadline.

exitTarget(address,uint256).notice: Pull USDC back from a venue into the vault. Locked after the recall deadline.

repay(uint256).notice: Always allowed, including while draws are paused or recall is active.

setLine(address,address[],address[]).notice: One-time bind to the credit line plus allowlists. Called by the deploy script after both exist.

swapAllowlisted(address,uint256,uint256).notice: Swap idle USDC to an allowlisted token via the immutable MockSwap (1:1 raw).
